processes.title: Host envelope and usable volume
processes.positiveOracle: Usable AABB is positive, finite in fixed-point terms and contained by outer AABB.
processes.negativeOracle: Missing usable geometry -> BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED; usable envelope outside outer body -> COMPLETE/FAIL.

processes.title: Mounting surface capability
processes.positiveOracle: Every selected surface resolves to one host-local frame and declared capability set.
processes.negativeOracle: Unknown capability never means unlimited capability; missing mandatory frame -> BLOCKED.

processes.title: Placement containment
processes.positiveOracle: Half-open subject body transformed into host frame is fully inside usable host/surface envelopes.
processes.negativeOracle: One micrometre beyond usable envelope is deterministic FAIL; unknown body depth makes depth unresolved.

processes.title: Volumetric placement collision
processes.positiveOracle: Touching half-open faces do not overlap; disjoint occupied volumes pass.
processes.negativeOracle: Positive-volume intersection between exclusive solids produces stable ordered FAIL findings.

processes.title: Rack U occupancy
processes.positiveOracle: Disjoint half-open U spans inside usable range with compatible lane semantics pass.
processes.negativeOracle: Overlapping exclusive U or span outside usable range is FAIL; unknown rack profile is BLOCKED.

processes.title: Rack rail and equipment depth fit
processes.positiveOracle: Selected mounting depth and body/protrusions remain inside declared rack capabilities.
processes.negativeOracle: Enough U with incompatible rail depth remains FAIL; missing mounting depth is UNRESOLVED.

processes.title: DIN interval and physical width occupancy
processes.positiveOracle: Module interval and exact physical width both fit when both bases are known.
processes.negativeOracle: Passing module count cannot hide physical rail-length overflow; duplicate interval is FAIL.

processes.title: Shelf/backplate/door mounting fit
processes.positiveOracle: Exact mounting mode and supported orientation match selected surface capability.
processes.negativeOracle: Geometric fit on a surface with incompatible mounting mode is FAIL, not PASS.

processes.title: Service and removal envelope
processes.positiveOracle: Declared service/removal volumes remain unblocked inside applicable host/access space.
processes.negativeOracle: Body fit with blocked removable connector/device service envelope is FAIL for that dimension.

processes.title: Door swing and access envelope
processes.positiveOracle: Conservative versioned swept envelope is collision-free for allowed opening range.
processes.negativeOracle: Door-mounted subject fitting closed but colliding during opening produces FAIL.

processes.title: Cable entry and gland/knockout occupancy
processes.positiveOracle: Unique cable-end assignments fit declared opening/count/area capability.
processes.negativeOracle: Same exclusive cable end claimed twice or explicit capacity exceeded is FAIL.

processes.title: Cable bend and connector strain-relief envelope
processes.positiveOracle: Adopted technical bend/connector envelope is unobstructed in enclosure-local geometry.
processes.negativeOracle: No technical bend-radius fact -> UNRESOLVED; never invent a generic radius.

processes.title: Internal wiring duct capacity basis
processes.positiveOracle: Exact declared bundle-area basis is aggregated without hidden normative fill factor.
processes.negativeOracle: Missing conductor/bundle area leaves utilization unresolved; it is not assumed zero.

processes.title: Terminal and patch physical capacity
processes.positiveOracle: Distinct physical terminations occupy compatible unique positions with explicit reserve.
processes.negativeOracle: Logical LAN capacity cannot substitute for missing physical patch position; duplicate claim is FAIL.

processes.title: Battery physical fit and handling
processes.positiveOracle: Exact selected battery physical definition fits with supported orientation and declared handling envelope.
processes.negativeOracle: Electrical Ah/runtime PASS does not imply physical fit; missing dimensions -> BLOCKED for body-fit.

processes.title: Shelf/surface support load
processes.positiveOracle: Exact integer-gram load <= adopted surface static-load capability.
processes.negativeOracle: Explicit overload is FAIL; unknown device mass makes affected margin UNRESOLVED.

processes.title: Aggregate mass, centre of gravity and stability basis
processes.positiveOracle: Mass and gram-micrometre moments aggregate exactly; output is a physical basis only.
processes.negativeOracle: Missing mass leaves CoG partial; no seismic/anti-tip compliance is inferred.

processes.title: Ventilation and airflow physical envelope
processes.positiveOracle: Declared openings/fans and required intrinsic airflow keepouts are physically unobstructed.
processes.negativeOracle: Blocked inlet/outlet envelope is FAIL; unknown airflow rating remains unresolved rather than guessed.

processes.title: Thermal-input preparation basis
processes.positiveOracle: Exact adopted heat-loss facts and physical cooling/ventilation facts produce a complete downstream basis.
processes.negativeOracle: Electrical load is not substituted for heat loss; missing thermal data yields PARTIAL/UNRESOLVED.

processes.title: Physical reserve capacity basis
processes.positiveOracle: Used/free/reserved are disjoint accounting sets and reserve is not counted twice.
processes.negativeOracle: A visual empty gap without explicit usable capacity/provenance is not guaranteed reserve.

processes.title: Observed physical segregation distance projection
processes.positiveOracle: Exact observed geometry/distance is exported without asserting a jurisdictional minimum.
processes.negativeOracle: Missing group envelope makes distance unresolved; no hardcoded separation threshold.

processes.title: Protective bonding physical evidence basis
processes.positiveOracle: Declared physical bond points/links are internally consistent and provenance-complete.
processes.negativeOracle: Absence of a declared bond is not silently treated as compliant/non-required; downstream rule decides requirement.

processes.title: Deterministic auto-layout proposal
processes.positiveOracle: Same canonical input and versions -> byte-identical proposal/score/hash; locked placement unchanged.
processes.negativeOracle: Unsatisfied hard constraints return unresolved subjects; solver never mutates canonical state.

processes.title: Aggregate enclosure layout validation
processes.positiveOracle: All applicable required intrinsic dimensions complete/pass while downstream normative dimensions remain NOT_ASSESSED.
processes.negativeOracle: Any required FAIL remains FAIL; any mandatory missing evidence prevents aggregate PASS.
